# FLX-8030: generated evidence prose contains reserved pre-receipt vocabulary

**Family:** evidence/pack (the 8000 band)

EVIDENCE.md is rendered from a fixed template, but a caller-supplied value (a bundle name, a conformance summary) can still introduce a word this project reserves until an external event lifts the freeze -- see scripts/register_lint.py. The report is refused rather than written with the word inside it.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-8030
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
